  • Sm (Atomic Number 62) :
  • Eu (Atomic Number 63) :
  • Yb (Atomic Number 70) :

In their divalent state (+2 oxidation state), the electron configurations would be :

  • Ce : (removal of the 2 electrons from the 6s orbital)
  • Sm : (removal of the 2 electrons from the 6s orbital)
  • Eu : (removal of the 2 electrons from the 6s orbital)
